The empire was divided into Maharashtrakas (provinces), then into smaller Rashtrakas (Mandala), Vishaya (district), Bhoga (group of 10 villages) which is similar to the Dasagrama unit used by the Kadambas. The coins had Nagari and Kannada legends.  The coins of Mangalesha had the symbol of a temple on the obverse and a 'sceptre between lamps' or a temple on the reverse.  Pulakeshin II's coins had a caparisoned lion facing right on the obverse and a temple on the reverse.
